isModuleType(uint256).details: Returns boolean value if module is a certain type

params.moduleTypeId: the module type ID according the ERC-7579 spec MUST return true if the module is of the given type and false otherwise

isValidSignatureWithSender(address,bytes.details: See {IERC7579Validator-isValidSignatureWithSender}. Ignores the `sender` parameter and validates using {_rawERC7579Validation}. Consider overriding this function to implement custom validation logic based on the original sender.

onInstall(bytes).details: Sets up the module's initial configuration when installed by an account. The `data` parameter should contain the P256 public key coordinates (64 bytes minimum). If the account doesn't already have a signer configured, the first 64 bytes of `data` will be used as the authorized P256 signer (qx, qy). See {_extractSigner} for more details about the encoding. Requirements: * The `data` must be at least 64 bytes. Reverts with {ERC7579P256ValidatorInvalidSignerLength} if not. * The `account` must have no signer installed. Reverts with {ERC7579P256ValidatorAlreadyInstalled} if not. * Decode `data` into `abi.encode(bytes32 qx, bytes32 qy)`. * The `data` must contain valid P256 public key coordinates. Reverts with {ERC7579P256ValidatorInvalidPublicKey} if not. Emits a {ERC7579P256ValidatorSignerSet} event if the signer is set.

onUninstall(bytes).details: Cleans up the module's configuration when uninstalled from an account. Removes the authorized P256 signer for the calling account. If the account has a configured signer, it will be cleared. If no signer is configured, this function will behave as a no-op. Emits a {ERC7579P256ValidatorSignerSet} event if the signer is cleared.

setSigner(address,bytes32,bytes32).details: Sets the P256 signer for the specified account. Requirements: * The `qx` and `qy` coordinates must not be zero. * The `qx` and `qy` coordinates must be valid P256 public key coordinates. * The caller must be the specified account. Emits a {ERC7579P256ValidatorSignerSet} event.

signer(address).details: Returns the authorized P256 signer for the specified account.

params.userOpHash: the hash of the ERC-4337 PackedUserOperation MUST validate that the signature is a valid signature of the userOpHash SHOULD return ERC-4337's SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (and not revert) on signature mismatch See {IAccount-validateUserOp} for additional information on the return value
